name: Woolston Hennebique reinforced-concrete construction
description: A reinforced-concrete system associated with François Hennebique was used in the structure of Woolston Quay, Southampton.

date.basis: The source reports the date for this scoped event or archaeological context.

events.statement: The museum dates the Woolston Quay reinforced-concrete section to 1899.

evidence.supports: The museum dates the Woolston Quay reinforced-concrete section to 1899.
The source attributes this contribution to francois-hennebique.

earliest_record.rationale: The earliest dated case currently researched, not a claim of the capability’s original invention or global priority.

caveats: The surviving section is evidence of this specific construction; its detailed reinforcement and actual loads need construction records.

research.note: Independent review checked the museum object account: 1899 is the date built, not a separately documented date of entry into service.
